phase: Unify profile counts and history-list authority. Forensic-confirmed root cause: pages/challenge-records and pages/report-history read ai_reports/challenge_records directly via wx.cloud.database().where({openid}); those collections are `private` (creator-only) and the rows are written by cloud functions carrying no `_openid`, so the client read is denied. challenge-records masked the failure as a false empty state; report-history masked it via a silent local fallback. Fix: two new READ-ONLY owner-scoped cloud functions getChallengeRecords and getReportHistory (identity from cloud.getWXContext().OPENID) return canonical paginated lists whose totals are computed by the SAME shared policy modules used by getProfileStats — lib/reportVisibility.js (byte-identical across getProfileStats + getReportHistory) and lib/challengeListability.js (byte-identical across getProfileStats + getChallengeRecords). profile.reportCount == getReportHistory.total and profile.challengeCount == getChallengeRecords.total by construction. Both pages rewired to the server APIs with explicit LOADING/EMPTY(SERVER_CONFIRMED_ZERO_ONLY)/ERROR(retry)/UNAUTHORIZED states; no silent local fallback, no false empty. Every listed report resolves to a supported detail route (challenge_final→report-preview; legacy6q→legacy6q-report) and every listed challenge to an action (processing→challenge-play resume; finished→challenge-result). Day capped at 30 with a documented day=31 storage-artifact audit. No payment/membership/callback/finalizer change; no historical data mutation; read-only DB.
scope: + cloudfunctions/getChallengeRecords/{index.js,package.json,config.json,lib/response.js,lib/challengeListability.js} (new read-only server list) + cloudfunctions/getReportHistory/{index.js,package.json,config.json,lib/response.js,lib/reportVisibility.js} (new read-only server list) + cloudfunctions/getProfileStats/{index.js,lib/reportVisibility.js,lib/challengeListability.js} (consume shared policy; remove stale countPolicy.js) + services/challengeService.js + services/aiReportService.js + pages/challenge-records/* + pages/report-history/* + cloudbaserc.json (register 2 fns) + tests + .changes/current-change.json.
